selected: reuse known-key lookups with an ordered fallback
method: Each measured pair launches separate Node processes. Elapsed includes startup and all request stages. Peak RSS is a process lifetime high-water mark. Phase probes wrap generated JS functions, so timings include probe overhead and numberMs is nested within boundMs. constraintMs wraps the candidate parser. A zero phase value indicates the corresponding path was absent or did not run. In reverse runs the first driver is the candidate. The inline trial emitted the same binary as each.
